subject: Barry changelog command
object: Markdown changelog output from implemented timeline facts without writing files by default

subject: Barry changelog write mode
object: to overwrite an existing changelog unless --rewrite is provided

subject: Barry changelog since mode
object: generated entries on or after the --since date for preview output or --write append output

subject: Barry changelog rewrite mode
object: the target changelog with the full generated changelog when --rewrite is explicit

subject: Barry changelog existing-file safety
object: --rewrite to replace an existing changelog file or --write --since YYYY-MM-DD to append filtered entries

subject: Barry changelog file-write flags
object: --write and --rewrite as mutually exclusive sufficient modes for writing changelog output to a file

subject: Barry changelog append mode
object: since-filtered generated changelog sections to an existing changelog with --write --since without duplicating the top-level Changelog heading

subject: barry-cache npm package
object: CHANGELOG.md through package files and a top-level README changelog link for npmjs visibility
